text: わたしの　まけね　しょうが　ない！

patterns.name: 〜ね
patterns.explanation: ね at the end softens the statement, like 'huh'. Putting it straight after the word with no だ sounds feminine. まけね = 'a loss, huh'.

patterns.name: しょうがない
patterns.explanation: A set phrase, literally 'there is no way to do it', said when you accept something you cannot change. しょうが　ない = 'it can't be helped'.
